library.locationDescription: Tracks, artwork, and the database are stored in this folder.
library.autoOrganize: Automatically organize music in the tracks folder
library.importModeDescription: “Add to Spiral library” copies files into the tracks folder and organizes them. “Keep files where they are” plays them from their current location and never changes them.

relocate.hasDatabase: A Spiral library already exists here. Your current library will stay at its old location.
relocate.foundFiles_one: Found {{count}} audio file at {{path}}. Move your current library here, or start a new library and import those files in place.
relocate.foundFiles_other: Found {{count}} audio files at {{path}}. Move your current library here, or start a new library and import those files in place.
relocate.empty: Or start a new empty library here.

sources.description: Spiral plays music from these places. Files in the Spiral library are copied in and organized; watched folders are played where they are.
sources.managedDescription: Files copied in and organized by Spiral.
sources.externalDescription: Files added one at a time from elsewhere, played where they are.
sources.watchedDescription: A folder Spiral watches and plays in place.
sources.offlineHint: Spiral can't reach this folder. Its tracks are marked missing until it's back, or you change its location.
sources.writable: Allow Spiral to edit tags in this folder
sources.writableDescription: Lets Spiral save tag, artwork, and lyrics edits into these files. Spiral never moves, renames, or deletes them either way.
sources.removeBody_one: Its {{count}} track leaves your Spiral library, along with its playlist entries and listening history. The files on disk stay untouched.
sources.removeBody_other: Its {{count}} tracks leave your Spiral library, along with their playlist entries and listening history. The files on disk stay untouched.
sources.scanSummary: Scan finished: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{missing}} missing, {{restored}} found again.

crossfade.description: Overlaps library tracks with a volume ramp. CD transitions still switch instantly.

listening.description: Spiral can record listening history for play counts and personal insights. Your history is yours, stored locally, and never shared with Spiral.
listening.clearAllBody: All personal insights will be permanently lost.

metadata.cdFetch: Fetch album metadata when inserting a CD
metadata.confirmMusicBrainzLinksDescription: Ask before opening a MusicBrainz page in your browser from the editor.
metadata.lyricsAutoFetch: Automatically fetch lyrics in lightbox mode
metadata.lyricsSidecar: Sync timed lyrics to LRC sidecar files
metadata.lyricsSidecarDescription: .lrc files are kept next to track files.
metadata.resetTagWriteWarningsDescription: Show the confirmation again before edits that write tags to your files.

studio.defaultPublisherIdDescription: Seeded into new items as publisherId. Changing this does not rewrite existing items.
studio.slugHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g. jane-doe).

automatic.label: Check for app updates automatically
automatic.description: Check for Spiral updates on launch and every few hours while Spiral is open.

automaticItems.label: Check for pack updates automatically
automaticItems.description: Check for new versions of Studio packs downloaded from the catalog.
